fusions.name: Binder's Awl
fusions.desc: Drives a binding awl through the layers of the target's plating for 8 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Writ Absolute
fusions.desc: Reads a writ aloud that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The damage ignores armour.

fusions.name: Pasted Plate
fusions.desc: Pastes sheet over sheet into a plate that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Riveted Boards
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 8% slashing resistance.
